description: Projected Masters field size for a PLANNED major, used only to decide which payout bands its kicker unlocks. Regionals and Specials are pooled per rating zone; each International is the median of its own last three seasons.
provenance: Limitless (limitlesstcg.com, limitlessvgc.com), which permits crawling. Its player count is the Masters count, cross-checked against rk9 (Seattle 2026 VGC 822 vs 821 Masters with a final standing) and Victory Road (Gdansk 2026 VGC 418 vs "Attendance 418 MA").
onlineEvents: Global/Grand Challenges and the GO Battle League Leaderboard Challenge have no published field size and are not regional. Every kicker is assumed met: Pokemon Champions has 10M+ downloads and the GO leaderboard is ranked globally.

assumedLocalField.note: Assumed turnout at a Cup or Challenge, used both to decide how deep the ladder may ask you to finish and to score a placement entered without a CP. Entering the CP is the evidence that overrides it.
assumedLocalField.caveat: A Cup at 32 behaves exactly as one at 17: the next band up (9th-16th) needs 48 entrants, so neither figure unlocks it.

assumedField.note: Flat field sizes stated by the repository owner, overriding the observed baselines below for the games listed. They are assumptions, not measurements: what they decide is which kickers a planned finish can clear, so a deliberate figure beats a median that happens to sit on the wrong side of one. Games absent here keep their observed medians; a TCG Regional really does run about 2,270.
